en.title: Ryanair cancels all flights to five destinations and exits Turkey and Serbia
en.summary: Ryanair cancelled all flights to five destinations in October 2026 — Dalaman and Bodrum in Turkey, Volos and Kalamata in Greece, and Nis in Serbia — pulling out of Turkey and Serbia entirely. The cuts are not seasonal, and the markets will not return in 2027.
body: Ryanair cancelled all flights to five destinations in October 2026, pulling out of Turkey and Serbia entirely. The last flights operated on October 23 and 24: Dalaman and Volos on October 23, and Bodrum, Kalamata and Nis on October 24. The cuts are not seasonal, and the markets will not return in 2027, although some could come back in the future. According to OAG data for November 2026, Ryanair operates 14% of Europe's short-haul flights and 17% of its short-haul seats, using only 189-seat Boeing 737-800s and 197-seat 737 MAX 8-200s.

In Turkey, Ryanair has now withdrawn completely. In August 2026 the country saw only 10 weekly departures — six to Dalaman and four to Bodrum — making it the least-served nation in the carrier's network. Turkey has no open-skies agreement with the EU or the UK, so the airline could only fly there from Dublin under its Irish air operator's certificate and from the UK through Ryanair UK. The report said marketing support for the Turkish routes did not materialise to the agreed extent.

In Serbia, Ryanair only ever served Nis, with just 11 departures in the peak summer of 2026, the second fewest of any country in its network. According to EX-YU Aviation News, the Nis withdrawal was linked to refuelling and fuel regulatory problems, and Ryanair has ruled out flying to Belgrade because of its high costs, although it continues to track the market.

zh.title: 瑞安航空取消5個目的地全部航班、全面退出土耳其與塞爾維亞
zh.summary: 瑞安航空10月取消5個目的地全部航班，包括土耳其達拉曼與博德魯姆、希臘沃洛斯與卡拉馬塔、塞爾維亞尼什，全面退出土耳其與塞爾維亞市場；這些航線削減並非季節性調整，2027年也不會恢復。
body: 根據OAG的2026年11月數據，瑞安航空佔歐洲短程航班14%、短程座位17%，機隊僅有189座波音737-800與197座737 MAX 8-200兩種機型。儘管規模龐大，瑞安航空10月仍一口氣取消5個目的地：達拉曼、沃洛斯、博德魯姆、卡拉馬塔與尼什，最後航班集中在10月23日至24日。報導指出，這些削減並非季節性調整，相關市場2027年也不會恢復，但未來仍有可能重返。
土耳其方面，瑞安航空退出後已完全撤出土耳其市場。2026年8月，土耳其每週僅有10個航班，分別為達拉曼6班與博德魯姆4班，是瑞安航空全網服務最少的國家。土耳其與歐盟及英國之間沒有開放天空協議，瑞安航空僅能以愛爾蘭航空營運許可證自都柏林、以及瑞安航空英國子公司自英國營運；報導指出，約定的行銷支援並未如期落實。
塞爾維亞方面，瑞安航空僅曾飛往尼什，2026年夏季高峰每週僅11個班次，是全網第二少的國家。根據EX-YU Aviation News報導，尼什航線取消與加油及燃油法規問題有關；瑞安航空也因貝爾格勒機場成本過高而排除飛往當地，但仍在關注該市場。
